findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 November 1947 and is recorded as active.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 28 February 2026 and the next accounts are due 26 August 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 18 June 2026 and the next is due 2 July 2027.
There are 2 outstanding secured charges, 0 part-satisfied and 7 satisfied, out of 9 charges registered.
There are 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.
Across 5 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, of which 53 are active, 25 dissolved, 4 converted closed and 1 in liquidation; one director is linked to a company in liquidation.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner.

headline.text: The company (00445790) is recorded as active, with no insolvency record, accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, and 2 outstanding charges among 9 registered.
